title: I tried to remake this game years ago but never finished it. AI helped me finally bring it to life in 2 days.
author: VibeCoder101
selftext:
This isn't a new or unique game idea. I've wanted to remake a game like this for years, and before the AI era, I actually started working on a prototype. But I never managed to finish it.

This time, I decided to give it another try using Unity, Blender and Claude. I honestly didn't expect to get this far in just 2 days. I'm genuinely surprised by how quickly AI helped me turn my idea into a playable game.

I'm not saying AI will replace real artists or designers. They have skills that I simply don't have. But as a developer with very limited design and artistic skills, AI has been an incredibly helpful tool. It helped me bridge that gap and build something I probably wouldn't have been able to finish on my own.

I'm really happy with how it turned out and wanted to share it. Would love to hear your thoughts and feedback!

comments.author: VibeCoder101
comments.body:
